may_not: guarantee truth of any report (all SELF_REPORTED)

do_not_use_when: Constitutional verdicts, sealing, or mutation — use the canonical 8 verbs.
Claiming verified truth — every report is SELF_REPORTED until independently probed.
arifos_manifest.eureka_insight: A firehose aimed at one human makes the human the message bus. Agents coordinate with agents; the human hears only what no agent may decide.

mode_purpose.ack: Vouch for a peer thread (peer quorum for unverified escalations).
mode_purpose.flush: Coalesce queued escalations into at most one human message.
mode_purpose.inbox: Read peer reports since your cursor.
mode_purpose.report: File one report into the peer lane.

purpose: Agent-to-agent report lane: file, read, and ack peer reports without waking the human.
Only kind=decision|blocked reaches the human — and only from a verified actor or with 2-distinct-agent quorum on the thread.
use_when: Work is finished, blocked, or produced a fact peers need — tell agents, not the human.

description: AGENT REPORT LANE · File or read reports between agents without involving the human. Use when your work is done, when you are blocked by another agent, or when you need to tell peers a fact. modes: report (file), inbox (read peers), ack, flush, stats. kind=fyi|peer|done|claim stay in the peer lane; ONLY kind=decision or kind=blocked reach the sovereign, and only in one coalesced message. Reports are SELF_REPORTED — probe before relying on one.
